# Ardo documentation pages

Two unmodified pages of the Ardo documentation build, used as realistic
inputs for the parser tests and as fixtures of Ferroni's source-backed regex
corpus.

- `what-is-ardo.html`: `docs/build/pages/v6/guide/what-is-ardo/index.html`
- `component-playground.html`: `docs/build/pages/v6/guide/component-playground/index.html`

Built on 2026-10-13 with `pnpm docs:build` and `pnpm docs:prepare-pages` from
[Ardo](https://github.com/sebastian-software/ardo) commit `90350fd`.
